name: capital_city
description: Name the capital of a country, few-shot 'Country: X. Capital: Y'. Control: same format copying country name.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
P=[('France','Paris'),('Germany','Berlin'),('Italy','Rome'),('Spain','Madrid'),('Japan','Tokyo'),('China','Beijing'),('Russia','Moscow'),('Egypt','Cairo'),('Canada','Ottawa'),('Australia','Canberra'),('Greece','Athens'),('Portugal','Lisbon'),('Norway','Oslo'),('Sweden','Stockholm'),('Finland','Helsinki'),('Poland','Warsaw'),('Austria','Vienna'),('Ireland','Dublin'),('Kenya','Nairobi'),('Peru','Lima'),('Chile','Santiago'),('Cuba','Havana'),('Thailand','Bangkok'),('Turkey','Ankara'),('Iran','Tehran'),('Iraq','Baghdad'),('India','Delhi'),('Argentina','Buenos'),('Hungary','Budapest'),('Denmark','Copenhagen'),('Belgium','Brussels'),('Netherlands','Amsterdam'),('Mexico','Mexico'),('Vietnam','Hanoi'),('Indonesia','Jakarta'),('Philippines','Manila'),('Colombia','Bog'),('Ukraine','Kyiv'),('Czech Republic','Prague'),('Romania','Bucharest')]
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    items.append({"prompt":"\n".join(f"Country: {a}. Capital: {b}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\nCountry: {s[3][0]}. Capital:","answer":" "+s[3][1]})
    s=random.sample(P,4)
    control.append({"prompt":"\n".join(f"Country: {a}. Name: {a}" for a,b in s[:3])+f"\nCountry: {s[3][0]}. Name:","answer":" "+s[3][0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
